summary: The stakeholder supports tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes to ensure child safety and protection from harmful content.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: Having the subsidy and making it dependent on clear protections that work to keep kids safe makes a lot of sense to me
claims.evidence_quote: I like the E-rate subsidy because it helps keep schools honest about protecting the kids' internet access. I care deeply that the schools have protections in place to keep children away from pornography and outside users who may groom them in some way shape or form. Therefore having the subsidy and making it dependent on clear protections that work to keep kids safe makes a lot of sense to me.
